svg.title: A window zooms open
svg.desc: A message window opening at the top of the screen in Vale, seen in five moments: first a thin bar, then a bigger box each frame, growing outwards from its centre, until it is full size; only then does the text begin, "Yo". A window takes 8 frames to open and 4 to close, shrinking back towards its centre, and it keeps its place among the window slots until it has closed. A window can also be asked to open and close at once, with no zoom.
svg.text: A MESSAGE WINDOW OPENING IN VALE
